name: file-upload
blurb: Animated file upload with grid pattern background and layout motion.
description: Drag-and-drop file uploader with animated file list display. Background has radial gradient grid pattern. Uses Framer Motion for layout animations.
use_when: Polished, visually distinct file uploads with emphasis on animation and design.
avoid_when: Performance-critical contexts; animations may strain older devices.
a11y: Input hidden but accessible. Drop zone keyboard operable via click handler.
